title: 第25章 绝世剑谱第26章 天云推荐信
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“楚天骄，你可要睁大眼睛，看清楚了！”
就在众人错愕的时候，楚天铭手起剑落，向着那金宫雕像劈去。
唰！
剑光闪过。
金宫立时崩碎，瞬间断为两截，犹如砍瓜切菜一般，轻松自如。
众人定睛看去，只见那金宫断裂的地方，赫然露出了乳白色的石面。
而且这些石纹大部分都是横纹，十分凌乱，正如楚天铭所言一样。
“我靠，这还真不是金曜石！”
众人都是目瞪口呆。
谁也没有想到，这块金曜石竟然是假的！
“楚天骄，你可看清楚了么？真正的金曜石，内外都是金色的，而你这块内部却是乳白色，是真是假，应该不用我多说了吧！”
楚天铭呵呵一笑，直接将那柄永霜剑收了起来。
当初，楚家就是用他来向韩家交换这把永霜剑。
今日，他将这把剑重新拿回韩家。
无异于给楚狂和楚天骄一记重击！
楚天骄看到自己高价买来的金曜石雕像，竟然是个赝品，更是直接瘫坐在地上，面如死灰道：“怎么……怎么会这样？”
岳秋莹也是瞠目结舌：“这金曜石还真是假的？清雪，你这夫君，难道还是个鉴宝大师？”
韩清雪抿嘴一笑：“他的本事可不止这些，以后你接触多了就知道了。”
闻言，岳秋莹吃惊的说不出话来。
而其余的人，也都是一个个瞠目结舌。

“楚狂，老城主过寿，你们楚家竟然送来一个假的金曜石来，是何居心？”
韩正德冷笑一声，开口质问。
“我……”
楚狂脸色铁青的说不出话来。
“这件事情，也不能怪楚家家主，毕竟这金灵石跟金曜石实在太像，一般人根本分辨不出来，所以楚家家主多半也是被骗了而已。”
老城主笑呵呵说道，显然是在给楚狂的一个台阶。
楚狂自然不傻，立刻回道：“老城主说的不错，我们也是被人所骗，否则怎敢拿这赝品来糊弄城主。”
“无妨，不管是什么石，都是一份心意，来人，将这雕像收下。”
老城主微微一笑，让人将那块被劈成两半的石头，收了起来。
而后，他又看向楚天铭，道；“楚公子，你是怎么知道这金曜石是假的？”
楚天铭淡淡道：“当然是看出来的。”
“看出来的？”
老城主看了那楚天铭一眼：“这么说来，你不是个瞎子？”
楚天铭淡淡道：“对，我已经恢复了视力，而且眼神比一般人还要好一些，所以才能分辨出来。”
“我去，诅咒之眼，竟然能恢复视力，这不是开玩笑吧。”
“是啊，我还是第一次听说这么匪夷所思的事情！”
听到楚天铭的话，大厅内一时哗然四起。
楚狂和楚天骄更是满脸的不可思议，显然做梦也没有想到，楚天铭的眼睛竟是恢复了视力！
这家伙是如何做到的？
老城主颔首一笑：“原来如此，看来天铭公子，是因祸得福了。”

“老城主过誉了。”
楚天铭抱了抱拳，谦虚的回了一句，旋即便坐回了席位之上。
“死瞎子等着吧，我早晚给你好看！”
看到楚天铭被老城主夸赞，楚天骄觉得本来属于自己的荣耀，被人夺走了一般，心里自然是愤恨不已，握了握拳头，暗暗发誓道。
content_en:
"Chu Tianjiao, you have to open your eyes and see clearly!"
Just when everyone was stunned, Chu Tianming raised his sword and struck at the statue of the Golden Palace.
Uh-huh!
The sword flashed.
The golden palace immediately collapsed and broke into two parts in an instant, just like chopping melons and vegetables, easily and effortlessly.
Everyone looked closely and saw that the milky white stone surface was exposed at the broken place of the golden palace.
Moreover, most of these stone patterns are horizontal and very messy, just as Chu Tianming said.
"Holy crap, this really isn't gold obsidian!"
Everyone was stunned.
No one thought that this piece of obsidian was actually fake!
"Chu Tianjiao, can you see clearly? Real obsidian is golden inside and out, but yours is milky white inside. I don't need to say more about whether it is true or false!"
Chu Tianming chuckled and put away the Everfrost Sword.
In the beginning, the Chu family used him to exchange the Everfrost Sword with the Han family.
Today, he took the sword back to the Han family.
It was tantamount to giving Chu Kuang and Chu Tianjiao a heavy blow!
When Chu Tianjiao saw that the golden obsidian statue he bought at a high price turned out to be a fake, he collapsed on the ground and said with a pale face: "How...how could this happen?"
Yue Qiuying was also stunned: "Is this golden obsidian real or fake? Qingxue, my husband, are you still a treasure appraiser?"
Han Qingxue pursed her lips and smiled: "He has more abilities than that. You will know when you get in touch with him more in the future."
Hearing this, Yue Qiuying was so surprised that she was speechless.
And the rest of the people were all dumbfounded.
"Chu Kuang, the old city lord is celebrating his birthday, and your Chu family actually sent you a fake golden obsidian. What's your intention?"
Han Zhengde sneered and asked.
"I..."
Chu Kuang's face was ashen and speechless.
"You can't blame the Chu Family Patriarch for this matter. After all, the Golden Spirit Stone is so similar to Golden Obsidian that most people can't tell the difference. So the Chu Family Patriarch was probably deceived."
The old city lord said with a smile, obviously giving Chu Kuang a step forward.
Chu Kuang was naturally not stupid, and immediately replied: "The old city lord is right, we were also deceived, otherwise how could we dare to fool the city lord with this fake product."
"It doesn't matter, no matter what kind of stone it is, it's all from my heart. Come, please accept this statue."
The old city lord smiled slightly and asked someone to put away the stone that was split in half.
Then, he looked at Chu Tianming and said, "Mr. Chu, how do you know that this golden obsidian is fake?"
Chu Tianming said calmly: "Of course I can see it."
"You can tell?"
The old city lord glanced at Chu Tianming: "So, you are not blind?"
Chu Tianming said calmly: "Yes, I have recovered my eyesight, and my eyesight is better than that of ordinary people, so I can distinguish it."
"Here, Cursed Eye can actually restore vision. Isn't this a joke?"
"Yeah, this is the first time I've heard of such an incredible thing!"
After hearing Chu Tianming's words, there was an uproar in the hall.
Chu Kuang and Chu Tianjiao had expressions of disbelief on their faces. Apparently they never dreamed that Chu Tianming's eyesight would actually recover!
How did this guy do it?
The old city lord nodded and smiled: "I see. It seems that Mr. Tianming is a blessing in disguise."
"The old city lord has given you too much praise."
Chu Tianming clasped his fists, replied humbly, and immediately sat back on his seat.
"Just wait, blind man. I'll give you a good look sooner or later!"
Seeing Chu Tianming being praised by the old city lord, Chu Tianjiao felt that the glory that originally belonged to him had been taken away. Naturally, he was filled with resentment. He clenched his fists and secretly swore.
